articles.title: A Giant Rodent Roamed Thailand 34 Million Years Ago
articles.summary: Fossil teeth found in a Thai mine reveal Yakamys sirindhornae, a rodent that may have weighed about 30 kilograms — twice as heavy as other rodents of its time.

articles.title: Children Helped Make the Middle East's Oldest Clay Figures
articles.summary: More than 150 clay figures made 11,500 to 15,000 years ago — some bearing children's fingerprints — are likely the Middle East's earliest of their kind.

articles.title: A Giant Planet Vanished — and It Isn't Coming Back for Decades
articles.summary: A 'hot Jupiter' 1,000 light-years away wobbled out of view as a neighboring planet tilted its orbit; astronomers say its next crossing is 30 to 50 years away.
